fixups.why: ISO C++ refuses a friend declaration with a default argument unless it is a definition (the probe's int.h:175). Natively the friends are the templates themselves, which is what VC6 instantiated (pk.cpp PKey::Generate calls Generate_Prime<BigInt>). The default third argument was never used (pk.cpp passes it).
